messages:
support-bot: heads-up: customer 'Crane' (acct: crane-inc) opened ticket #12345 — reports ~3x increase in p99 latency on /v1/generate since ~02:00 UTC. See brief metrics: p50 120ms -> 140ms, p95 210ms -> 560ms, p99 480ms -> 1.6s :rotating_light:

maria-ops: thx. can someone grab traces + a sample request id? want to know if it's longctx or kernel-related.

raj: grabbing traces now. I see a spike of stalled KV-cache hits around 02:05 UTC for a few pods. pulling example req ids — 8f3a1b, 8f3a7c, 8f3b22.

kevin: dropping a quick perf snapshot on one of the affected hosts. looks like GPU memcpy wait increased in the hot path. will upload flame later.

lucy: any recent changes rolled to runtime around that window? I merged the kernel-selector tweak yesterday evening but it shouldn't affect hosted customers — only dedicated.

sam: @maria-ops @raj can we confirm model variant routing? customer is pinned to rwd-mix-v2-8q8. fallback policy existed?

maria-ops: customer is pinned. fallback disabled per their security profile.

raj: postfix of traces shows a sudden batch size jump in the dispatcher for those requests (from 4->12). not sure why batcher picked larger batches — maybe the batching heuristic mis-sampled traffic distribution.

kevin: here's the perf snippet I uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-internal/prof/2223334445/crane-host-1.pb.gz. flame shows memcpy stalls between attention kernels. suspect kernel selection picked an int8 kernel with a slow path on this hw.

lucy: that lines up with a change in kernel scoring we pushed in the selector last week (weights updated). rolling that scoring config back is low-risk.

sam: can we do an emergency routing rule to keep Crane on a previous kernel profile without a full rollback? ie route by customer tag to legacy kernel.

maria-ops: yes, we have routing override. I can push temporary policy to route crane-inc -> kernel-profile:legacy-2025. Will take 2 mins. anyone opposed? :thumbsup:

raj: +1 please do. also collecting more traces while we switch.

kevin: created a quick PR to add a safety check in the batcher heuristics to cap batch growth on short bursts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8421. pinging reviewer @lucy.

lucy: looking now. small nit but LGTM otherwise. can we add a unit test for the edge case (very small concurrent QPS spikes)?

kevin: will add test in follow-up. want the hotfix merged before we flip routing.

maria-ops: push policy now -> status: applied. routing override active for crane-inc. monitoring now.

support-bot: update: routing override applied at 2223334502.

raj: traces after override look cleaner — batch sizes back to 3-5, no KV stalls yet. preliminary p99 numbers dropping toward previous baseline.

sam: nice. plan: keep override, merge the batcher safety PR + revert kernel-scoring change (or pin legacy profile for pinned customers) — then monitor for 24h.

lucy: I'll prepare the revert for kernel scoring and add an ops-feature-flag so we can enable gradual rollout.

kevin: will follow up with the unit test and an e2e perf check in CI (adding a synthetic burst test).

maria-ops: assigning actions: @lucy revert kernel scoring + flag, @kevin merge batcher fix + test, @raj collect 24h traces and post summary, @maria-ops keep routing override until further notice.

deploy-bot: scheduled job: rollback-kernel-scoring will run in the canary pool at 2223337200 UTC if approved.

sam: thanks team. adding notes to ticket #12345 and cc'ing account manager. will do a quick customer update: "we've applied a temporary routing change and are rolling back a kernel scoring change; monitoring shows improvement."

maria-ops: please paste the short customer message here before sending, I'll approve.

sam: paste: "Quick update: we've applied a temporary configuration change that routes your inference traffic to a legacy kernel profile and are reverting a recent selector tweak. Early metrics show p99 dropping back toward normal; we'll monitor and follow up with a full postmortem."

maria-ops: approved. sending now.

support-bot: ticket #12345 update posted at 2223334599.

raj: leaving this thread open for the 24h summary. will post final numbers + traces.

kevin: thanks — if we see recurrence after revert, we should also instrument kernel microbench for the exact hw SKU.

lucy: agreed. adding microbench task to the follow-up.

maria-ops: good work. closing the immediate escalation but keeping assigned tasks. :white_check_mark:
